query:
SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oci_tag WHERE manifest_id = $1)
             OR EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1
                 FROM oci_manifest p
                 JOIN oci_manifest_ref r ON r.manifest_id = p.id
                 WHERE p.repository_id = $2 AND p.image = $3 AND p.id <> $1
                   AND r.kind = 'manifest' AND r.digest = $4
             )) AS "kept!"
